subject.title: fix(zai): send current GLM thinking params

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Z.ai provider-wire change based on official docs, two-builder tests, and the BigModel/Z.ai live GLM-5.2 proof, or require separate `api.z.ai` proof first?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but the remaining uncertainty is the maintainer-owned proof threshold for a provider wire contract that could affect real Z.ai users if hosts diverge.

options.title: Accept Current Proof
options.body: Merge after normal exact-head gates because both builders are aligned and the redacted BigModel/Z.ai GLM-5.2 proof matches the documented contract.

options.title: Require Overseas Host Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted `api.z.ai` GLM-5.2 live run before merge if maintainers require host-specific validation.

options.title: Wait for Replacement
options.body: Pause this PR only if another linked PR first lands equivalent two-builder coverage with comparable live proof.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal exact-head gates because both builders are aligned and the redacted BigModel/Z.ai GLM-5.2 proof matches the documented contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent GLM-5.2 provider support and reviewed Z.ai reasoning-level work make this the clearest owner route for provider-contract acceptance.
